candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes organizing pneumonia, and while the patient is on tacrolimus, the biopsy findings and the resolution of the initial PJP infection followed by new infiltrates are consistent with organizing pneumonia, not specifically tacrolimus-induced pneumonitis. The record does not provide evidence to link tacrolimus as the cause of the organizing pneumonia.

The clinical record describes a patient who developed new infiltrates and biopsy-proven organizing pneumonia after treatment for Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia (PJP). This sequence of events strongly supports a post-infectious etiology for the organizing pneumonia.
